Showcase

Sites and experiments I make on my own time. This page isn’t linked anywhere yet.

  • GeekFixx live · 2023

    A wellness app that looks after you while you look at a screen.

    Uses machine learning to correct your posture, and nudges you to look away from the screen, drink water, and take breaks. The oldest thing on this page, and still the one most likely to tell you to sit up straight.

    React, Machine Learning, Python

    github.com

  • The Homelab live · 2025

    The bare-metal box this site runs on.

    A server at home that serves rajatdev.fun to the open web. The uptime guarantee is simple: if you can read this, it is up.

    Linux, Astro, Self-hosted

    rajatdev.fun
